label: exploratory/post-hoc
limitations: All intervals are post-hoc/exploratory; no frozen verdict is revised.
Held-out AUROCs are computed on all test rows (answerable rung 0 vs rungs 1-4) from band_score in predictions.csv; no model is retrained.
Cluster resampling uses article title as the cluster id and is reported alongside, not instead of, item-level resampling.
Audit OOF scores reuse the 5-fold, seed-13 audit construction from r3_exp_auroc_ci / r3_exp_audit_twosided; the bootstrap seed is 20261118.
The gold-indicator column is a label-construction artefact; its AUROC is not evidence about rung hardness.

resampling.item_level: bootstrap_auroc_ci / paired_auroc_diff_ci with cluster_ids=None (resample item rows with replacement)
